chunks.title: About Us – Punjab Khussa House
chunks.text:
Punjab Khussa House brings you handcrafted traditional Pakistani khussa footwear — made by skilled artisans using quality leather and detailed embroidery.
Our collection covers Khussa, Peshawari chappal, Kherri and Kolhapuri styles for men, women and kids — traditional craft, made for everyday comfort.
Authentic handcrafted khussa from Punjab
Free shipping all over Pakistan
Cash on Delivery available
Easy payment via JazzCash, Easypaisa, SadaPay, NayaPay or bank transfer
Please note: we currently deliver within Pakistan only.

chunks.title: Contact Us – Punjab Khussa House
chunks.text:
Have a question about a product, your order, or a size? We are happy to help.
Send us a message through the contact form on this page and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
For order questions, please include your order number so we can help you faster.
We deliver all over Pakistan via TCS courier, with Cash on Delivery available nationwide.

chunks.title: Privacy Policy – Punjab Khussa House
chunks.text:
Last updated: 20 October 2026
Punjab Khussa House (“we”, “us”) respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect when you shop with us and how we use it.
# Information we collect
Order information: your name, phone number, delivery address and order details, so we can process and deliver your order.
Payment receipts: if you pay by JazzCash, Easypaisa, SadaPay, NayaPay or bank transfer, you upload a payment receipt so we can verify your payment.
Contact messages: anything you send us through the contact form.
# How we use your information
To process, pack and deliver your order via TCS courier.
To verify payments and handle returns or exchanges.
To respond to your questions.
We share your delivery details with our courier (TCS) only to deliver your order. We do not sell your personal information.
You may ask us to view, correct or delete your personal data. Contact us through the contact page on this website.

chunks.title: Terms & Conditions – Punjab Khussa House
chunks.text:
Last updated: 20 October 2026
These terms apply to purchases from Punjab Khussa House through this website.
We deliver within Pakistan only.
Shipping is free all over Pakistan .
Orders are dispatched via TCS courier.
Cash on Delivery (COD) is available nationwide.
Prepaid orders can be paid via JazzCash, Easypaisa, SadaPay, NayaPay or bank transfer. Please upload your payment receipt at checkout so we can verify your payment and process your order.
Our khussas are handcrafted. Small variations in colour, stitching or embroidery are a natural part of handmade footwear and are not defects.
Please see our Returns & Refunds page for the full policy.

chunks.title: Returns & Refunds – Punjab Khussa House
chunks.text:
Ordered the wrong size? We offer a size exchange within 7 days of delivery, provided the khussa is unworn, unused and in its original condition and packaging.
# Damaged or incorrect items
If your order arrives damaged, defective or different from what you ordered, contact us within 48 hours of delivery with a photo of the item. We will arrange a replacement or a refund.
Approved refunds are processed to the same payment method used for the order (JazzCash, Easypaisa, SadaPay, NayaPay or bank transfer). For Cash on Delivery orders, refunds are made by bank or mobile transfer.
Refunds are processed after we receive and inspect the returned item.
# Items that cannot be returned
Worn or used items cannot be exchanged or refunded unless they are damaged or defective on arrival.
# How to start a return
Contact us through the contact page on this website with your order number and the reason for the return, and we will guide you through the next steps.
